text: dsh-fft-paper-trading 是面向 DSH Web 的 A 股与商品期货模拟交易插件。它在侧栏提供交易面板，并向对话注册股票、期货和账本工具。用户可查询行情、预览并提交模拟订单、管理持仓与挂单、按 CSV 权重批量配置股票组合，并查看交易复盘；账本保存在本机。适合希望在 DSH 中练习或复盘交易的人。行情由 FTShare 数据服务提供；免费模式可用日线收盘价，实时行情需在 FTShare 设置中配置 API Key。

dsh-fft-paper-trading adds simulated A-share and commodity futures trading to DSH Web. Its sidebar and chat tools support quotes, orders, and reviews. Ledgers are stored locally. FTShare supplies market data; daily closes work without a key, while real-time quotes require an FTShare API key.
想在 DSH 里用虚拟资金练习买卖 A 股。
我想在不连接券商的情况下模拟商品期货交易。
能不能先估算下单费用和成交后还剩多少现金？
帮我按 CSV 里的权重分配预算，批量建立股票组合。
I want to review my simulated trades and see drawdown and fills.
Can I check futures quotes and manage paper orders from chat?
股票模拟下单：dsh-fft-paper-trading 提供股票模拟交易：在面板或对话工具中填写标的、方向、数量及市价或限价，先预览价格、费用和成交后现金，再提交订单；未到连续交易时段的订单可排队等待撮合。
期货账户与订单：dsh-fft-paper-trading 提供商品期货模拟账户：可查询合约与行情、预览开平仓订单并管理持仓和挂单。期货委托由对话工具触发，成交与结算信息写入独立期货账本。
交易复盘与账本：dsh-fft-paper-trading 提供股票交易复盘和账本管理：可按 7 天、30 天或全部区间查看表现，也可通过共享账本工具查看快照、备份或恢复股票及期货账本。
dsh-fft-paper-trading 使用 FTShare 行情服务；未配置 API Key 时回退到最近日线收盘价，实时行情接口需要在 FTShare 设置中配置密钥。

> DSH ≥ 0.2.0-rc.2 · quotes, trading calendar and K-line built in · ledger stored locally

@dsh-ft/dsh-fft-paper-trading README · What it looks like：*Review page: period statistics, equity curve, fills, end-of-day report and cash flows.*

*Futures page: open long / open short / close long / close short, with contract terms, margin and risk ratio on one screen.*

@dsh-ft/dsh-fft-paper-trading README · Features：- **Everything is priced before you place the order**: type a symbol, side and quantity, and the estimated fill price, commission, stamp duty, transfer fee, post-trade cash and maximum affordable quantity all refresh together — there is no separate quote lookup or preview step.
- **Stocks and futures, two independent accounts**: both accounts are created automatically the first time you open the panel — 1,000,000 CNY of simulated cash for A-shares, 1,000,000 CNY for commodity futures; futures trade in lots, reserve margin, allow same-day (T+0) closing and settle at end of day.
- **One ledger shared with the AI**: say “buy 200 shares of 000001 at market” or “review my trades this week” in the conversation and the model calls the ordering and review tools directly; the panel and the model trade the same account.
- **Order straight from the K-line**: the panel keeps a full K-line chart on screen; pick a symbol on the chart and its code is carried over to the trade page. The quotes page lets you page through sectors and add the symbols you follow to the shortlist.

@dsh-ft/dsh-fft-paper-trading README · Install：```sh
dsh plugin add @dsh-ft/dsh-fft-paper-trading
```

Requires DSH `>= 0.2.0-rc.2`. The plugin ships FTShare quotes, the trading calendar and the K-line view, so no separate data plugin is needed.

@dsh-ft/dsh-fft-paper-trading README · Install：- The full K-line view needs Python 3.10+ on this machine and prepares its runtime over the network on first launch; a failed preparation does not affect ordering, positions or review.
- **Do not** install it alongside `@dsh-ft/dsh-fft-bundle` or any other entry package that ships the FTShare data service: the data service row would be duplicated, and the related entries in the plugin manager could no longer be toggled separately.

@dsh-ft/dsh-fft-paper-trading README · Get started in three steps：In the conversation, you can simply say:

- “What is 600519 trading at right now?”
- “Buy 200 shares of 000001 at market, with the note: testing T+1”
- “Review my stock trades this week”

@dsh-ft/dsh-fft-paper-trading README · Market data and API keys：Configure the API key in DSH under “Settings → Financial Terminal”; request one at <https://ftai.chat/ftshare>.

The panel header shows the data-source state (live / free / unavailable / invalid); when quotes are unavailable it says why and offers “Get API key” or “Retry”. When the trading calendar degrades to “Monday to Friday”, the panel flags it (holidays then count as trading days, and T+1, pending-order expiry and settlement are estimated on business days).
